name: Ahmed II
role: Sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1691 to 1695

checks.lead: Ahmed II (Ottoman Turkish: احمد ثانی, romanized: Aḥmed-i sānī; Turkish: II. Ahmed; 25 February 1643 or 1 August 1642 – 6 February 1695) was the sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1691 to 1695.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
